text:
maya (Comms): Following the postmortem, we need a defensible external comms flow: statuspage blurbs, 72h customer summaries, and rules for publishing RCAs. Who takes the redaction checklist?

kevin (SRE): I'll draft the checklist. Plan: explicit rules for logs, hostnames, IDs, and config snippets.

sara (Customer Success): Timeline request: 72h initial summary, CS-ready snippet, and an ETA for the full RCA. Customers want clarity on next steps.

ben (Legal): 72h summary is fine. Any RCA with customer-identifying info requires legal review. I'll prepare a quick sign-off matrix.

triage-bot: Reminder: create task INCIDENT-7110 with 72h due for initial customer summary.

maya (Comms): Proposed statuspage short (single sentence) and 72h template below. Please react or propose edits.

```
Statuspage short: "We experienced elevated errors impacting <service>. Mitigation deployed; service restored at <end>. A follow-up summary will be posted within 72 hours."

72h customer summary (recommended):
- Impact: <concise impact>
- Mitigation: <what we did>
- For your customers (3 lines): <CS-ready blurb>
- Next steps & owner (name + ETA)
- Support link / contact

RCA public (post-redaction): timeline, cause, remediation, verification, owner + ETA, link to postmortem. Redaction per checklist.
```

kevin (SRE): For the redaction checklist I'll include: remove PII/keys, mask customer hostnames to GENERIC_HOST_{n}, strip request/response bodies that include identifiers, avoid verbatim stack traces if they include file paths with customer IDs. Also add a `customer_consent_required` flag.

sara (Customer Success): Consent flag is essential. If we want to include a customer quote or example, we need documented opt-in and copy approval. CS can coordinate consent.

ben (Legal): I'll add a simple flow: redaction -> legal review -> comms review -> publish. If customer quote included: obtain written consent with exact quoted text. I'll draft the consent template.

kevin (SRE): Suggest adding a `recurring-pattern-check` to the postmortem template: auto-query last 180 days for matching error signatures and flag if >1 match. That will help comms decide if proactive outreach is needed.

maya (Comms): Yes please. If recurring pattern flagged, we escalate to a "proactive outreach" checkbox and expand 72h summary to include remediation timeline.

sara (Customer Success): Also request: include a short "customer impact severity" field in the 72h summary (e.g., "partial degradation", "major outage") so CS teams can triage outreach priority.

kevin (SRE): I'll add both: `recurring-pattern: yes/no` and `customer-impact-severity` to the template. Will attach the sample query in the PR.

triage-bot: Action created: INCIDENT-7110 (customer-comms)  Due in 72h.

maya (Comms): Action owners and due dates:
- redaction checklist: kevin (owner)  due 48h
- statuspage + 72h templates: maya (owner)  due 24h
- consent template & sign-off flow: ben (owner)  due 72h
- CS reusable snippets: sara (owner)  due 4 business days

ben (Legal): I'll include examples of disallowed content and a short FAQ for engineers about redaction pitfalls.

sara (Customer Success): Will prepare the 3-line "for your customers" blurb and a paste-ready email template.

kevin (SRE): Opening PR with checklist + `recurring-pattern` query in 1 hour. Link will be shared here.

maya (Comms): Thanks all. Please react with :+1: to accept assignments.

kevin (SRE): :+1:

sara (Customer Success): :+1:

ben (Legal): :+1:

maya (Comms): Leaving thread open for edge cases (regulated customers, air-gapped deployments). Tag me and legal if a special-case incident appears.

triage-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow up in 24h for progress updates.
